column4: A single sheet of old cream drafting paper from the 1990s seen flat from straight above and filling the whole frame edge to edge, aged warm cream colour, soft fold creases in a cross where it was folded in four, a faint coffee ring near one corner, slight foxing specks and grey pencil smudges, worn soft corners. Completely blank: no writing, no drawing, no lines, no text, no stamp. Plain flat scan, even light, slightly dithered like a texture in a 1996 PC game.
